timeline: Ch1: Sloane Mercer wakes up on the rooftop of Vertigo Building, discovers her sister Mara's dead body, and finds a contract in her own handwriting designating herself as a target for termination at sunrise.

facts_established: Sloane Mercer is a federal investigator.
Sloane's sister Mara is dead on the rooftop of Vertigo Building.
Sloane has no memory of the past three months.
Sloane found a contract on herself, in her own handwriting, stating she is to be terminated at sunrise on the current day.
Sloane has a nervous habit of rubbing her left thumb on her right wrist.
spice_progression: The first chapter establishes a high-stakes mystery: a federal investigator wakes up from a three-month memory loss to find her sister dead and herself the target of a hit contract written in her own hand, setting a tense, psychological tone.
phrases_used: The contract said her name, but the body at her feet was her sister's.
